name: MOP AI Indexer – LLMs.txt and LLMs-Full.txt Generator
author: Anjana Hemachandra

sections.description:
Activate the plugin → Configure index file generation → Run a test → Set it to auto-generate

MOP AI Indexer generates lightweight, readable index files for AI crawlers and LLM tools. It lets you control which post types and posts are included, supports manual and scheduled generation, provides cache control, and respects SEO directives. You can select the index file name as llms.txt or llms-full.txt, depending on the amount of content written to the index file.

MOP AI Indexer – llms.txt and llms-full.txt generator – Quick Introduction

YouTube video link…

Features

  • Manual index generation and deletion (AJAX)
  • Scheduled generation via WP‑Cron
  • Public endpoint to serve generated files
  • Built-in cache control
  • Per‑post exclusion via meta box
  • Optional inclusion of custom fields (human‑readable)
  • Generation logs with status and timestamps
  • Defensive integration with SEO plugins (e.g. AIOSEO)
  • Safe file handling using temp files and atomic swaps

Resources

Documentation: https://ministryofplugins.com/mop-ai-indexer-docs/
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • PHP version 7.4.0 or greater.
  • WordPress 5.6.0 or greater.
  • The website should not be a WordPress multisite.

Installation

  • Method 1: Install and activate the MOP AI Indexer plugin via the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  • Method 2: Download the MOP AI Indexer plugin zip, extract it, and upload its contents to the wp-content/plugins/ directory. Then, activate the plugin from the Plugins page in the WordPress Admin area.
sections.faq:
Does this change my content?

  • No. It only reads content and generates a separate index file (llms.txt or llms-full.txt) for LLM consumption.

Where are the index files stored?

  • They’re saved in the WordPress uploads directory at /wp-content/uploads/mop-ai-indexer/ and served via a controlled endpoint.
